subject: Karim Benzema
title: Benzema: six months, one Dubai flat

lines.vo: Six months at Al Hilal. Benzema's best signing: a Dubai flat.
lines.footage: Vision Iconic Tower Dubai flats, Binghatti launch

lines.vo: A fifty-one million pound replacement was announced the day before he left. That is not a hint. That is a billboard.
lines.footage: Ollie Watkins Al Hilal signing highlights

lines.vo: Lyon called a return more noise than reality. Mourinho dug up his 2010 cat story. Some stories have nine lives.
lines.footage: Lyon Benzema France TV interview clip

lines.vo: Zidane says he adores Karim. Then he picked a France squad without him. Adoration from a distance.
Zidane calls him the best French striker in history. Five Champions League titles and twenty-five trophies at Real Madrid back that up.
lines.footage: Benzema best goals Real Madrid compilation

lines.vo: So the best French striker in history will watch from home. Probably from a very nice flat.

inserts.story: A cartoon shirt rack holds blue Al Hilal shirts, and a number nine shirt marked Benzema sits at the end. Gag: a cartoon delivery man wheels in a giant number nine shirt with a 51m tag and both try to fit one hanger. Twist: Benzema's caricature slides his shirt onto a hanger marked Free agent, with a tiny Dubai key hanging off it.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon delivery man and shirt rack; caricature of Karim Benzema

inserts.story: A caricature of Mourinho in hunting gear whistles for a dog. Instead a smug cartoon cat with five tiny crowns strolls up and sits on his hat. Twist: the cat flips a tag that reads Nine lives, one used at Al Hilal.
inserts.characters: caricature of Jose Mourinho; cartoon cat (stand-in for Benzema)

inserts.story: A caricature of Zidane stamps ADORE in big red letters on a France squad list while a caricature of Benzema peers over his shoulder. Twist: the stamp lands on the empty space where a name should be, and the ink blot looks like a small heart.
inserts.characters: caricature of Zinedine Zidane; caricature of Karim Benzema
